headline: MIT Technology Review will host a live interview on 16 October with Stanford student Samuel King, who used generative AI to propose genetic blueprints for viruses.
score_reason: An event notice with no new result; one point below the pool score.
importance_line: Readers curious about AI-designed biology can hear the researcher directly, but the item reports no new finding and the work itself dates from 2025.
summary: MIT Technology Review announces a live Roundtables conversation on 16 October between its AI reporter James O'Donnell and Samuel King, a bioengineering PhD candidate at Stanford University and the Arc Institute, who in 2025 used a generative AI model to propose genetic blueprints for microscopic viruses. The magazine says this is not yet AI-generated life, but that could be next.
